description: This file contains initialization and configuration code for the Renesas DA1469x system-on-chip, including cache setup, power management, and system reset functions.

methods.name: sys_arch_reboot
methods.description: Triggers a system reset using NVIC_SystemReset().

methods.name: z_renesas_configure_cache
methods.description: Configures the cache memory and remaps IVT, triggered during platform init if MCUBOOT is enabled.

methods.name: z_arm_platform_init
methods.description: Initializes platform-specific features, including cache configuration if MCUBOOT is enabled.

methods.name: renesas_da1469x_init
methods.description: Performs system initialization, including watchdog freeze, clock setup, power management, and system reset configuration.
